original_sql:
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM orders
WHERE YEAR(o_orderdate) = 1995
GROUP BY o_orderpriority
ORDER BY o_orderpriority

candidates.sql: SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority
candidates.rationale: Replaces the non-sargable YEAR() function with a range predicate on o_orderdate, allowing the optimizer to use an index on o_orderdate if one exists, or at least perform a more efficient range scan.
